surprises: IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W395-S1: the premise that the new route reuses _summary_named_accounts does not hold; the filled document nests its accounts and carries no firm or client_id key, so the pair needs a new named-account reader.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W395-S2: the premise that the route owner must add an IAM read on the new key does not hold at HEAD; the reporting-read role already reads the whole platinum reporting prefix and the API invoke grant covers the path.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W395-S3: hop 2 publishes a filled report, but no production writer of the document exists and no landing address is named; the input contract's source is absent and the CTO is asked who writes it and where it lands.

IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W395-S4: the order's trigger for a registry row (a builder refusal) does not occur; the naming builder accepts the new object name, so the registry need rests on the closed family set in reporting_policies.json.
